title: Dalai Lama meets John Mack about aliens

tellings.quote: The Dalai Lama also met with Harvard psychiatrist John Mack about aliens and expressed a similar companionship of worldviews.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the Dalai Lama, the spiritual leader of Tibetan Buddhism, met in the 1990s with John Mack, a Harvard psychiatrist, to talk about aliens. According to Michels, the Dalai Lama found that his own worldview and Mack's fit well together, which would suggest a major religious figure took such encounters seriously.
